name: Napier Art Deco Trust
bio: The Art Deco centre of town, with guided walks and a shop beside the main streets rebuilt in the 1930s.

name: Marine Parade
bio: A palm-lined seafront with gardens, sculptures, the Pania of the Reef statue and a long pebble beach.

name: National Aquarium of New Zealand
bio: An aquarium of native fish, sharks and reptiles, with a kiwi house.

name: Cape Kidnappers
bio: A headland with the largest mainland colony of Australasian gannets, reached by tractor-trailer tour or beach walk.

name: Te Mata Peak
bio: A 399-metre peak above Havelock North with panoramic views of Hawke's Bay and, on clear days, Mount Ruapehu.

name: Bluff Hill Lookout
bio: A hilltop lookout over the port, the town and the Hawke's Bay coast.

name: MTG Hawke’s Bay
bio: A museum, theatre and gallery on Tennyson Street, with an exhibit on the 1931 earthquake.
